human_intent: Recover and route work on a Prometeo surface that does not yet have a dedicated active workstream.
already_decided: Do not reconstruct the entire repository by default.
Use the matched surface card and Catalog/source pointers.
Do not claim or assume write ownership until a scoped workstream exists.
Promote reusable discoveries through normal shared ownership rather than duplicating them page-locally.
high_value_targets: Recover the user’s unfinished request with minimum context overhead.
Identify where the symptom appears and who should own the solution.
Create a small scoped workstream only if material writes are needed.
known_failures: Treating every new page request as a reason to redesign global architecture.
Using a page symptom to justify duplicating an existing shared capability.

relevant_global_deltas.summary: Prometeo now has one stable agent entrypoint, NOW router, scoped task packs, delta propagation and compact returns. Fresh chats should route before repository archaeology.
relevant_global_deltas.action: Start from `.well-known/prometeo.json`; do not reconstruct every historical subsystem before knowing the task.

relevant_global_deltas.summary: Prometeo Agent Runtime v2 compiles one current Work Packet per active workstream, includes only relevant cross-chat/branch deltas, defines FAST/DEEP/EXHAUSTIVE/CONTINUE profiles, and adds the visible Prometeo Seal.
relevant_global_deltas.action: Prefer the compiled packet from `/agent-runtime/manifest.json` over manually reconstructing NOW/PACK/RETURN/DELTA. `Prometeo` means resync+recover+continue; `.` means continue the active frontier. Print `🟣 P✓` only after entry+packet were actually loaded.

FAST.use_when: The requested change is explicit, local, reversible and does not require material architectural decisions.
forbidden_overhead: release receipts for ordinary LAB iteration

DEEP.use_when: The task is materially ambiguous, multi-file, design-heavy or benefits from deciding the space before editing.
sequence: CONTEXT FIRST: write the material understanding that can change execution
COMPLETE MAP: name all meaningful parts before diving into part one
DEVELOP: resolve important decisions under those headings
EXECUTE: implement as much of the map as tool/context boundaries allow
CRITIQUE: inspect the actual result for contradictions and lost value
REPAIR: fix worker-soluble failures in the same work cycle
DEEP.rule: Context/map/specification are decision compression, not deliverables to endlessly regenerate.

EXHAUSTIVE.use_when: The human explicitly requests exhaustive coverage/a numbered map, or the work is structural enough that omission risk dominates.
sequence: print the complete requested title map once
develop it at the requested depth
execute continuously from the frozen frontier
rules: A requested count such as 100 is a coverage matrix, not permission for filler.
After PLAN:FROZEN, later turns must not regenerate the same plan.
N/A or DEFER with a reason is better than fake work.
A response-length boundary is not a project boundary; persist the frontier and continue.

CONTINUE.use_when: The conversation already has a materially sufficient context/map/specification or the human sends dot to continue.

automatic_selection.explicit_exhaustive_or_existing_frozen_l: EXHAUSTIVE or CONTINUE when already frozen

Prometeo: Resync before answering the unfinished human intent.
Load the stable entry and current runtime manifest.
Infer the current workstream/surface from the conversation; do not ask the human to repeat context when it can be recovered.
Prefer one compiled active Work Packet. If no active workstream matches, use the catalog surface route plus the compiled GENERAL packet rather than guessing or crawling the whole repository.
Recover branch drift from packet activity deltas rather than restarting repository archaeology.
Choose the execution profile and continue the last materially unsatisfied request.
End with a Prometeo Seal only if the runtime and a compiled packet were actually loaded.
If a Prometeo workstream is already active, continue its current execution frontier without regenerating context/maps/specification.
If no runtime packet is active, resync Prometeo first and continue the previously agreed next action.

seal.rule: Never print 🟣 P✓ unless the current stable entry and one compiled packet were successfully loaded during this work cycle.

instructions: Use the matched surface card first.
Recover the unfinished request from the conversation.
Read only source/capability owners that can change the current decision.
Before material writes, establish a scoped workstream/branch/write scope instead of writing ad hoc to main.
